extensionDescription.message: Connect reading pages in your browser to your local Auri Desktop library.

actionConflict.message: This change needs to be confirmed in the Auri app.

actionFailed.message: Couldn't complete the action. Please try again.

loadingDescription.message: Looking up this page in Auri.

unsupportedDescription.message: Open an HTTP or HTTPS page and try again.

disconnectedDescription.message: Open Auri on your computer to use this extension.

integrationUnavailableTitle.message: The Auri browser integration isn't configured.

integrationUnavailableDescription.message: Repair the browser integration from Auri Desktop and try again.

incompatibleTitle.message: This extension version isn't compatible with your current Auri version.

incompatibleDescription.message: Update Auri Desktop or the extension and try again.

errorTitle.message: Couldn't connect to Auri right now.

errorDescription.message: This may be temporary. Please try again.

notFoundTitle.message: This work isn't in your Library yet.

addWorkSuccess.message: Auri opened to add the work.

ambiguousTitle.message: We found more than one possible work.

ambiguousDescription.message: Choose which one you'd like to open.

previousChapterHint.message: This page is behind your current progress.

sourceUnlinkedDescription.message: This page isn't linked as a source yet.

sourceAmbiguousDescription.message: Auri couldn't confirm this source safely.

progressConfirmedDescription.message: Chapter $CHAPTER$ was confirmed in your local Auri library.

progressMismatch.message: Couldn't confirm chapter $REQUESTED$. Auri reported that the saved progress is chapter $SAVED$.

progressMissing.message: Couldn't confirm chapter $CHAPTER$. Auri reported no saved progress.

progressRejected.message: Auri rejected the update. This operation did not save the chapter.

progressSentUnconfirmed.message: The update was sent, but the saved chapter could not be confirmed.

progressUncertain.message: It is unclear whether the update completed. Check the saved progress before updating again.

progressWrongWork.message: The response belongs to another work. This work’s details were kept.

progressInvalidEvidence.message: The returned chapter could not be compared safely.

progressConnectionInterrupted.message: The connection to Auri was interrupted. Check again to verify the saved chapter.

possibleMatchDescription.message: This page may match the work below, but its identity has not been confirmed. Check in Auri before linking sources or updating progress.

progressInvalidRequest.message: The chapter could not be sent. Check the details before trying again.

progressWeakIdentity.message: The new lookup could not confirm the work’s identity safely. Check in Auri before updating again.
